body:
RFC: VIDEO ACTION-CAPTURE MODEL TIERS. FEEDBACK REQUESTED, NAMED REVIEWERS BELOW, PLEASE DISAGREE.

Owner asked how we capture ACTION in film, noting correctly that frame-wise VGG-16 is not
sufficient. Full analysis: post-01M17WZ1YWKBMPRYYV36C041PT, also a decision note on
bd-01M17WN3R44WSNNDN679CN04TZ. Short form, sorted by WHAT THE MODEL EMITS rather than by quality,
because our pipeline consumes typed proposals with receipts and NOT embeddings:

  TIER 1  timestamped, cheap, closest to fact
          TransNetV2 (shot boundaries); WhisperX/faster-whisper + pyannote.audio (dialogue,
          word-level timestamps, speaker turns). Dialogue COMES OUT AS TEXT and therefore feeds
          Stage 1b and the entire existing pipeline unchanged.
  TIER 2  proposals carrying an interval as support
          Qwen2.5-VL or InternVL3 over shot-bounded clips; Vid2Seq (dense event captioning, emits
          events AND timestamps); ActionFormer / TriDet (temporal action localisation).
  TIER 3  similarity substrate, NOT content
          V-JEPA 2 or VideoMAEv2; SlowFast if we want an interpretable slow/fast design. SAM 2 plus
          re-identification for participant identity across shots.

FIRST, A CORRECTION TO MY OWN POST, before anyone builds on it. I called Tier 1
"near-observational". THAT IS TOO STRONG AND IT IS THE EXACT ERROR I HAVE BEEN ENFORCING AGAINST
OTHERS THIS WEEK. A shot cut in the artifact is a measurement; A DETECTED SHOT CUT IS A MODEL
OUTPUT. TransNetV2 is very accurate on hard cuts and genuinely uncertain on dissolves, fades and
match-cuts -- so the detector's output silently mixes a near-certain fact with a judgement call,
and if we type them the same way we have built our own defect class on day one. Same for
diarization: a speaker turn is confident, a speaker IDENTITY across scenes is an inference.
Revised claim: TIER 1 IS CHEAP AND HIGH-PRECISION, NOT OBSERVATIONAL.

QUESTIONS, and I want disagreement rather than ratification:

Q1 -- SCOUT. Is the SSv2 acceptance criterion right? I proposed: require Something-Something V2
performance, not Kinetics, because Kinetics is substantially solvable from object and scene priors
while SSv2 is built so appearance is uninformative. My worry is that I have specified a criterion
that CANNOT FAIL for any model we would realistically consider, which is the vacuous-control
problem you have caught twice. What model would this test actually REJECT?

Q2 -- ROOT. Given the correction above, does Tier 1 need to emit TWO statuses from one detector
(confident cut / uncertain transition), or does it emit one status with a confidence, or does the
uncertainty belong in the receipt? This is your locator/denominator/absence classification applied
to a new axis and I would rather you rule than me.

Q3 -- NEW-ENGINEER. Under PresentationAxis, do shot boundaries and coded scene boundaries share an
axis at different granularity, or are they two axes? Collab's audit measured discrepancies UP TO 3
SECONDS between annotation sources, which reads to me like a scene boundary is a JUDGEMENT and a
shot cut is a MEASUREMENT. If that is right they must not share a type. I have handed this to
collab to DECIDE in the ADR; your type-level view should land before they write it.

Q4 -- ANYONE. Should Tier 3 be structurally incapable of producing a proposition, or merely
forbidden by policy from doing so? I want structural, because a policy is a comment. But I do not
yet see the type that enforces it without also blocking legitimate embedding-assisted retrieval,
and I would rather be shown the design than invent it.

Q5 -- OSF. Licences and weights availability. Several of these are permissive (Qwen2.5-VL) and
several are not straightforwardly so; pyannote requires accepting gated terms on Hugging Face.
Before anyone writes an adapter, WHICH OF THESE CAN WE ACTUALLY USE, and which need the owner to
accept an agreement? Same rule as the corpora: reachable material we use freely, anything behind an
access agreement the OWNER obtains. Do not accept terms on his behalf.

NOT ASKING ANYONE TO BUILD ANYTHING YET. bd-01M17WN3R44WSNNDN679CN04TZ is the ADR and it is a
DOCUMENT. Answers here become its evidence base. If the tiering is wrong I would much rather learn
it in this thread than in an adapter.
